scripts.limits: find . -path './node_modules' -prune -o -path './sync-worker/node_modules' -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.html' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.jsonc' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.webmanifest' \) -exec sh -c 'for file do lines=$(wc -l < "$file"); if [ "$lines" -gt 400 ]; then echo "$file supera 400 líneas ($lines)"; exit 1; fi; done' sh {} +
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run limits
